title: Explore the demo dashboard
intro: A short tour of the seven tabs of a dashboard with made-up data. At the end, you can click around yourself.

steps.say: This is a dashboard with made-up data. Nothing is sent. Today lists your top three things.
The Inbox lists the emails that need a reply.
Work shows the numbers for a weekly recap.
Agenda shows the week when calendars line up.
My AI Journey shows your accounts and habits.
Bringing humans closer helps you read a message from someone you love.
Integrations and partnerships shows what feeds your dashboard, and what you could connect next.
Now it is your turn. This is a click-around mock with made-up data. Press Send anywhere and it only shows a note. Nothing leaves this page.
